decisions.request_ids: Show every request number, with natural wrapping and row height; no line clamp or ellipsis. The displayed number count equals the adjacent count.

address_variants.compact: One line with ellipsis and full address in title; use only where the page contract selects it.
address_variants.full: Entire address with natural wrapping and row height; selected for this transfers table.

decisions.destination_from_request: Separate first line По адресу заявки N in standard IBM Plex Sans 12/700/16.8, then the full address in registry-ui-primary 12/500/16.8. Direct address has no request line.
decisions.history: Clicking ID or double-clicking a row opens the existing block history.
decisions.returned: Hidden by default; Показать возвращённые reveals rows using existing registry-ui-muted.
decisions.header_icon: Exact Tabler outline arrow-right-square through the shared renderer.

excluded: New shared visual treatment of forms, popups or action menus
Page-local copies of shared component styles
Production database, schema or business-data writes
